name: Eve is Right: Femdom Island
source:
Eve is Right: Femdom Island is a story-driven visual novel where gentle dominance slowly grows into irresistible power.

You awaken on a strange island with no memories of who you are or why you are there. The only thing certain is this: the women of the island are not like any you’ve ever met. A mysterious force has changed everything — fueling their natural desire to dominate and binding men to the thrill of submission.

Every day you meet new girls, uncover secrets, and decide how far you’re willing to go. Will you resist, or will you surrender to the pleasure of being controlled?
translation:
《伊芙是对的：女尊支配岛》是一部剧情驱动型视觉小说，温柔的掌控将在不知不觉间化作令人难以抗拒的绝对支配。

你在一座陌生的小岛上醒来，完全想不起自己是谁，也不记得为何会流落至此。唯一确定无疑的是：岛上的女人们与你此前见过的任何女性都截然不同。一股神秘的力量改变了一切——它激发了女人们天性中的支配欲，也将男人们牢牢束缚在臣服的快感之中。

每一天你都会邂逅新的女孩、揭开隐秘真相，并决定自己愿意走到哪一步。你究竟会奋起抗拒，还是甘愿沉沦于被人掌控的欢愉之中？
